question: In a certain code language, ‘ADAPTATION’ is written as 'DAPAATITNO', ‘SKATEBOARD’ is written as ‘KSTABEAODR’. How will ‘LIGHTBOARD’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2345ec0397b010a5433b27dbeadbed435fb53432cb9eec97c357421e5f215e69.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cf35428b1178f4bf620b1815d3de8f0cd4b0630eb6782d55250f8f14dee6383.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e3e711882e33feb187aef360529ab7cfce6df64d3a6f7cadb9a820f2b2c35bc.png] 

Hence, **'****ILHGBTAODR'** is the correct answer.
